__comment__: HIDE/ANIMAL GLUE: Collagen glue used since 200,000 BCE. Bones, sinew, tendon ~30% collagen (triple helix of Gly-Pro-Hyp). Boil 6-12h at 80-100C in water: collagen denatures, hydrolyzes into gelatin (partial hydrolysis). Dry to 15% water = glue cakes. Reversible, strong (30MPa shear). Used to haft tools, furniture, and yes, post paper. Recipe: tendon/sinew/bone + water low boil.
